topic_zh: AI 帮人点外卖，至今才几百单：DoorDash CEO 亲口说
topic_en: AI agents have placed only a few hundred DoorDash orders, ever, says the CEO

sources.title: DoorDash said it's only received several hundred orders from AI agents
DoorDash Releases Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat

xhs.title: AI帮你点外卖？DoorDash：至今才几百单
xhs.body:
第三方 AI agent 帮人在 DoorDash 点外卖，到现在一共可能才几百单。而 DoorDash 光第三季度就有 9.93 亿单。这是 CEO 在上周三财报会上亲口说的。
奇怪的是路已经铺好了：DoorDash 9 月推出了 MCP 下单连接器（小范围测试），沃尔玛也开了 agent 入口，亚马逊却在拦。
我的看法：缺的不是接口，是信任。做 agent，先做人工审批和花钱上限。
考考你：亚马逊和沃尔玛，谁在拦 AI agent 购物？评论区告诉我～

douyin.title: AI帮人点外卖，至今才几百单？
douyin.body:
DoorDash CEO 亲口说：第三方 AI agent 到现在一共可能就几百单，而上个季度总订单 9.93 亿。路已经铺好了，卡住的是信任。
考考你：亚马逊和沃尔玛，谁在拦 AI agent 购物？评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: AI agents have placed maybe several hundred DoorDash orders. In total. DoorDash did 993 million orders last quarter alone, says the CEO. The plumbing (MCP) is there. Trust is the bottleneck. Quick quiz: Amazon or Walmart, which one is blocking AI agents from shopping? #AINewsEveryday

quiz.q_zh: 亚马逊和沃尔玛，谁在拦 AI agent 购物？A 亚马逊 B 沃尔玛
quiz.q_en: Amazon or Walmart: which one is blocking AI agents from shopping? A Amazon B Walmart
quiz.answer_zh: 答案 A：亚马逊开始拦 agent 在站内购物；沃尔玛反而开了 MCP 入口，11 月起还支持每单审批和花钱上限。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: A. Amazon has started blocking AI agents from buying; Walmart opened an MCP agent gateway, with per-order approval and spending limits from November.
